description: Use this when the user asks about public subsidies or grants in Japan that may cover advertising or video production costs. Returns currently open national and local programs listed on jGrants (the Japanese government's subsidy portal) whose eligible costs include, or may include, advertising or video production. Programs confirmed to cover advertising costs come first, then by nearest deadline. Can be filtered by prefecture (nationwide programs are always included) and industry. Results are for reference only; eligibility and award are not guaranteed.

industry.description: Industry keyword in Japanese (e.g. 製造業 / 宿泊業 / 小売業).

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default 10, maximum 20.

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture, in Japanese (e.g. 香川県). Nationwide programs are always included.

role.description: The user's position: company = a business commissioning production or advertising / creator = a videographer, editor or other creator / agency = an advertising agency or production company.

name: find_subsidies

error.description: Reason the request could not be answered, in Japanese.

message.description: Message for the user, in Japanese.

needRole.description: true when the call was made without `role`; nothing else is returned.

notAvailable.description: true when the tool is not available for the given role.

note.description: Notes that apply to the result, in Japanese.
